entities.summary: The Singapore Indoor Stadium, known exonymously as the Indoor Stadium, is an indoor arena located in Kallang, Singapore. It is within walking distance of the Singapore National Stadium, and collectively form a part of The Kallang. It has a maximum total capacity of 15,000 depending on configuration, with an all-seating configuration of 12,000.
